newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,077.25.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,077.25.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.25 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,077.25 on steady selling of U.S. currency on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the dollar sales came from oil and coffee exporters as well as banks.
Dealers reported an above-average 232 trades for a total of $101 million and said the peso hit an intraday high of 1,075.35 before edging lower ahead of the close.
